Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPopulation_too: Controls automatic survivor population targets. Lowering this never deletes existing persistent survivors.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.SettlementDensity: Controls future faction settlement targets around relevant explored sectors.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RoamingGroupDensi: Controls future roaming abstract survivor-group targets.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PopulationRegener: Controls how quickly lost roaming groups may recover after their cooldown.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.SettlementRegener: Controls slow replacement of destroyed settlements. Destroyed sites retain a longer cooldown.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MultiplayerPopula: Adjusts diminishing population growth from player count and the number of distinct active sectors.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PopulationGenerat: Controls the server-side exclusion and preferred generation bands around connected players.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCMeleeWeaponSpa: Independent identity-seeded chance that a generated NPC receives a melee weapon. Melee and ranged rolls can both succeed.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCRangedWeaponSp: Independent identity-seeded chance that a generated NPC receives a firearm and matching ammunition. Melee and ranged rolls can both succeed.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ZombiesTargetDown: When enabled, zombies may continue targeting and deliver a final blow to incapacitated NPCs. When disabled, zombies release downed NPCs so players may revive them.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMo: Uses stamina immunity, crowd pressure, Fitness mitigation, clothing durability, and wound downgrading for zombie attacks on NPCs.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageSt: NPCs above this stamina ratio cannot take zombie damage through the new resolver. Set to 1 for full-stamina-only immunity or 0 to disable the gate.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageBa: Low-stamina damage chance before crowd pressure. The default 0 preserves one-zombie equals 0 percent crowd contribution.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageHi: Same-floor radius used to count living zombies for the damage roll.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr: NPC Zombie Crowd Chance per Extra Zombie (%%)
Added damage chance for each zombie after the first inside the hit zone. The default produces 0, 5, and 10 percent for one, two, and three zombies.
Additional quadratic crowd pressure after the third zombie. Set to 0 for a purely linear sequence.
Maximum crowd contribution before stamina and skill mitigation.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageFi: Additional damage-roll mitigation across Fitness levels 0 through 10.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMa: Upper cap on Fitness and defensive-skill mitigation.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing: Controls how clothing condition reduces bite and scratch defense. Higher values make worn clothing degrade protection faster.
Global multiplier for the clothing protection roll after item defense and condition are combined.
NPC Zombie Clothing Laceration Downgrade Threshold (%%)
Protection required for a penetrating bite or laceration to drop one wound severity step.
NPC Zombie Clothing Scratch Downgrade Threshold (%%)
Protection required for a penetrating bite or laceration to become a scratch.
NPC Zombie Clothing Safe Durability Loss
Item condition points lost when clothing successfully blocks a zombie attack.
NPC Zombie Clothing Penetrating Durability Loss
Item condition points lost when clothing fails and a wound penetrates.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieWoundCha: Base chance that a zombie lunge creates a wound. Armor on the struck body part reduces the final chance; failed rolls are parried.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieBiteChan: Chance that a successful zombie wound is a bite.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieLacerati: Chance that a successful non-bite result becomes a laceration; remaining wounds are scratches.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieInfectio: Chance that an NPC bite becomes Knox infected. Set to 0 to disable infection without changing zombie attacks or bite wounds. Infected NPCs develop fever, lose health, die, and reanimate.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta: In-game hours from infection to terminal fever and death. Health declines during the later stages.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCReanimationSec: Real-time seconds between infection death and vanilla corpse reanimation.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.EnableWeaponDamag: Uses each NPC's equipped weapon damage and combat skill. Disable to use legacy combat-profile damage values.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCDamageDealtMul: Scales weapon-based damage dealt by PNC NPCs. 1.0 is normal and 0 prevents weapon-based damage.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPlayerWounds_t: Allows PNC NPC attacks to cause pain, scratches, and bleeding on players in addition to overall health loss.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCAmmoConsumptio: Requires ranged PNC NPCs to carry the firearm's ammunition in their virtual inventory and consumes one round per resolved shot.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCWeaponConditio: Allows equipped PNC NPC weapons to lose virtual condition when attacks hit.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ComponentDeconstr: Percentage of a component's Base.Money ingredients returned to colony storage when the component is deconstructed.
